name: quake
summary: Quake (1996) — id Software's software-rendered engine + shareware episode 1 data (WinQuake subset, GPL v2)

quake.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Quake resolves its data (./id1/pak0.pak) and writes config.cfg relative
# to the CWD (sys_sdl.c basedir "."), so run it from wherever this package
# actually lives — /opt/quake installed, /usr/opt/quake baked (fat image).
# $0 arrives through symlinks (/usr/local/bin or /usr/bin); realpath(1)
# canonicalizes them (todos/0263 — libc realpath resolves symlinks now).
cd "$(dirname "$(realpath "$0")")" && ./quake-bin "$@"
